patient_text: Yes, it is recommended to separate your levothyroxine with calcium carbonate (trade name: Tums) by at least 4 hours. Medications including calcium, iron, magnesium, and aluminum prevent the absorption of the thyroid hormone and should be taken 4 hours after your levothyroxine. It is best to take your levothyroxine first thing in the morning or at bedtime, 3 to 4 hours after your last meal.

patient_text: It is not recommended to take Ibuprofen with your Warfarin as this increases your risk of internal bleeding and stomach ulcers. Warfarin will slow down blood clotting, and Ibuprofen will irritate your stomach lining. You should only take Warfarin and Ibuprofen together if specifically told by your doctor to do so. Ask your pharmacist for more information.
